story.title: Children Bear Heavy Toll in DRC's Severe Ebola Outbreak
story.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing its deadliest Ebola outbreak, with children particularly affected. Reports indicate that more than 1 in 4 of the deaths are among children, who face a staggering 60% fatality rate. This outbreak is caused by a rare strain of the virus for which there is currently no approved treatment.

timeline_highlights.title: Congolese Politician Beaten After Promoting Ebola Awareness
timeline_highlights.summary: Marie-Celestin Karondwa, a politician from the ruling UDPS party in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, was beaten on Sunday after advocating for Ebola awareness during a radio interview. The incident occurred in Butembo, a region experiencing an Ebola outbreak, as residents reacted violently to his message promoting disease prevention measures.
key_facts: Marie-Celestin Karondwa was a member of the UDPS party.
He was attacked after a radio interview about Ebola awareness.
The incident took place in Butembo, North Kivu province.

timeline_highlights.title: Kenya Reports First Confirmed Ebola Case and Death Following Return from DRC
timeline_highlights.summary: Kenya has confirmed its first-ever case of Ebola, resulting in the death of a man who had recently returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Health authorities have identified 28 contacts of the deceased as they monitor the situation closely. The outbreak in the DRC has been severe, with over 4,000 deaths reported this year.
key_facts: First confirmed Ebola case in Kenya.
The patient died after returning from the DRC.
28 contacts have been traced by health authorities.

timeline_highlights.title: Kenya Reports First Ebola Death and Traces 28 Contacts
timeline_highlights.summary: Kenya has confirmed its first-ever Ebola death, involving a Kenyan citizen who had returned from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The health minister announced that 28 contacts of the deceased have been identified as authorities respond to the outbreak. The situation has raised concerns among health workers and residents in Nairobi, prompting calls for better protection measures for medical personnel.

related_stories.summary: The Vatican has shared the first images of Pope Leo XIV following his surgery to remove a cancerous tumor from his right lung. Doctors report that the 71-year-old pontiff is showing steady improvement after the procedure, which took place on Tuesday.

related_stories.title: Pope Leo XIV Discharged from Hospital After Lung Cancer Surgery
related_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV was discharged from Gemelli Hospital in Rome on Saturday after undergoing surgery to remove a cancerous tumor from his right lung. The 71-year-old pontiff had part of his lung removed and was deemed fit for discharge by his doctors, who confirmed his diagnosis of lung cancer earlier this week.

related_stories.title: Three Men Sentenced to 158 Years for Murdering Surfers in Mexico
related_stories.summary: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men to 158 years and nine months in prison each for the murders of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their American friend Carter Rhoad. The trio was killed during a surfing trip in Baja California in 2024, reportedly during an attempted robbery.

related_stories.title: Katie Zacharia Leaves White House Press Secretary Role After Just Five Days
related_stories.summary: Katie Zacharia has exited her position as White House press secretary after only five days, stating it was an honor to serve. Reports indicate she was let go following public scrutiny and a series of blunders that distracted from President Trump's midterm campaigning efforts.
